split_intervals: train < cut80; cut80 <= validation < cut90; test >= cut90
catalog: full released static text catalog union observed items
cold_start_reference: union of items and users in retained training histories and targets
invalid_timestamp_policy: quarantine record; suppress all targets of that user
date_label_policy: when precise time and timestamp agree, date is not an event identity field; preserve and flag inconsistent labels, with duplicate label differences recorded in the ledger
dedup_feedback_policy: integer durations plus original watch_ratio decimal text; preserve distinct decimal feedback without float rounding
ambiguous_timestamp_policy: retain structural positions; reject intersecting blocks; omit tied events from ordered history
text_snapshot_assumption: released static metadata is available offline; contemporaneous availability is not established
